evidence: AC14: 'the call itself fails (timeout, 4xx/5xx, rate limit, malformed body) — the report emits a recipe with a VISIBLE placeholder lower bound ... and the step still exits 0'
AC21: 'the empty-history path emits the degraded message instead of raising' — enumerates only empty-history, not call-failure
AC14 is mapped in Verification to test_main_health_report.py but AC21 is the only criterion describing that suite's assertions
findings.finding: AC14 requires graceful degradation across several distinct failure modes (empty history, timeout, 4xx/5xx, rate limit, malformed body), but the coverage-pinning criterion AC21 only enumerates the 'empty-history path'. The error-injection paths (API call fails) have no criterion pinning a test, so the most likely production failure — the API call itself erroring — could regress unnoticed.
scenarios: The Actions API times out or returns 500 during a scheduled run; the script raises instead of degrading and a green main goes red — the exact failure AC14 exists to prevent, with no test guarding it.
findings.suggested_fix: Amend AC21 to read: '...and both the empty-history path AND each simulated API-call-failure path (timeout, 4xx/5xx, rate-limit, malformed body) emit the degraded placeholder message and exit 0 instead of raising.'

evidence: AC11: 'resolved from the workflow's own successful run history via the Actions API (status=success on the current branch)'

Established repo pattern: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml lines 58-60 pair `actions: read # read reconcile-bridge.yml run history` with `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (line 411 of reconcile-bridge.yml); gerrit-verify.yaml line 38 `actions: read # workflow-conclusion queries this run's jobs`

scripts/canary_bridge.py line 187 confirms the endpoint surface `gh api repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1` (MATCH — the integration is feasible; only the token/permission precondition is missing)
ABSENCE: neither AC11, AC14, AC15, nor 'Files this touches' mentions `permissions`, `actions: read`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, or `GH_TOKEN`
findings.finding: The Actions-API integration (AC11: resolve last-known-green via `status=success` on the current branch, emitted from the new main-health-report job in test.yml per AC15) does not state its auth precondition: test.yml currently declares only `permissions: contents: read`, but querying the Actions run-history endpoint requires `actions: read` plus a `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` exposed to the step. Without both, `gh api` returns 403 and the report permanently degrades to the AC14 placeholder.
scenarios: Scheduled/dispatched run executes main-health-report; `gh api` returns 403 because the job token lacks actions:read; every run silently takes the AC14 degraded placeholder path and the last-known-green lower bound is NEVER resolved in practice.
findings.suggested_fix: In test.yml, give the new main-health-report job `permissions: { contents: read, actions: read }` and pass `env: { GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }` (or GITHUB_TOKEN) to the step invoking scripts/main_health_report.py, so the `gh api .../runs?status=success` call authenticates instead of 403-degrading.
